Paragraph: "This sweet scent of mangoes fills the air, yet it tastes bitter to me because my Seetha is not here to share it..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Fragrant scents feel bitter due to the inability to share them with Seetha.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama acknowledges how missing shared experience alters sensory enjoyment.
Outcome/Resolution: He voices the pain of unshared joy.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Sahabhogita (The principle that true enjoyment requires sharing with one's beloved)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Reflects that divine abundance (Phala) is meant to be enjoyed in communion, not in isolated separation.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Relational enjoyment deficit: sweet sensory experiences feel emotionally empty or bitter when unshared with an attached partner.
